# Brickwater

> Brickwater is Bricky Waters (Roman Deska): indie, folk and punk from Nürnberg, Germany. Solo with guitar and harmonica, or with the Folk's Worst Nightmare collective. German site at the root, English under /en.

## Key pages
- Home (DE): https://www.brickwater.de/
- Home (EN): https://www.brickwater.de/en/
- Shows (DE): https://www.brickwater.de/konzerte/
- Shows (EN): https://www.brickwater.de/en/shows/
- Music and lyrics (DE): https://www.brickwater.de/musik/
- Music and lyrics (EN): https://www.brickwater.de/en/music/

## Releases
- Season One (album, 2018, LP on Raptor Records / Folk's Worst Nightmare): https://www.brickwater.de/musik/season-one/
- Jumping just to fall (single, 2018): https://www.brickwater.de/musik/jumping-just-to-fall/
- Against Couragefalls (album, 2016): https://www.brickwater.de/musik/against-couragefalls/
- Aloah from Brickwater (EP, 2015): https://www.brickwater.de/musik/aloah-from-brickwater/

## Facts
- Genres: indie, folk, punk. Songs are in English.
- Based in Nürnberg (Nuremberg), Bavaria, Germany. Active since 2015.
- Member of the Folk's Worst Nightmare collective (Nürnberg).
- Booking: brickwater@gmx.de
- Official profiles: https://brickwater.bandcamp.com/ https://open.spotify.com/artist/3ExCH2eoMuC70pzonI5N05 https://music.apple.com/de/artist/brickwater/1425452026 https://www.instagram.com/brickwater_/ https://www.youtube.com/@folksworstnightmare1528
